**Security Mode Complete without the NAS container**

| | |
|---|---|
| Group | NAS / 5GMM common procedures / Security mode control procedure |
| Tags | negative, security |
| Verdict class | WARN |
| Requires | Rel-15 |
| Up to | 20s at the default `--per-test-timeout` |
| Phase | main |
| Needs | NG Setup, registration |

## Clauses

- TS 24.501 4.4.6 a) (Rel-15 onward; Rel-15: V15.0.0 has no clause 4.4.6 and protects the initial NAS message with a hash instead; the cleartext IEs and the NAS message container are in V15.7.0 and unchanged in substance through V19.8.0)
- TS 24.501 5.4.2.2 RINMR (Rel-15 onward; Rel-15: V15.0.0 has the AMF send a hash of the REGISTRATION REQUEST instead; the RINMR bit is in V15.7.0, for a REGISTRATION REQUEST that failed the integrity check; Rel-16: adds the case that the AMF cannot decipher the NAS message container IE of the REGISTRATION REQUEST)

The quoted normative text and the release history of each clause are in the check's [provenance](https://github.com/grewelltech/orbit/blob/main/docs/conformance/provenance/NAS-INITIAL-MSG-NO-CONTAINER.md).
